scope_decisions.decision: NSL v0.1 is the language version; Runtime v1.0 denotes the first implementation release.
The mandatory quality gate is statement coverage >= 95% and branch coverage >= 90%.
Workflow language, multi-skill orchestration, WRITE, and APPROVAL are outside the NSL v0.1 baseline.
Scheduled single-skill execution is a platform extension and is not NSL syntax or IR.
Every SRS requirement remains tracked; MUST, SHOULD, and MAY differ in release obligation but not in traceability obligation.
